messages:
Arjun Desai: heads up — v1.0.7 of the llama3-70b-instruct INT8 profile is borderline on the regression gate. before we publish to the library, we need to decide whether to block.

Arjun Desai: profile ref: `qpl://llama3-70b-instruct/int8_w8a16/calset-rw-v3@1.0.7` (candidate for “validated”)

Jonas Weber: I’m looking at the week-1 eval summary now. Which suite is failing?

Arjun Desai: Redwood Prompt Set “tool-use/structured” (the one that stresses JSON validity + tool args consistency). The delta is small but consistent.

EvalsBot: Eval run complete: `run_2025-03-07_03-12Z` (route: perf-canary/quant-profile-ab)
- Model: llama3-70b-instruct
- Baseline: fp16
- Variant: quant profile `int8_w8a16@1.0.7`
- Suites: rw_prompt_sets_v5
- Result: FAIL (1 suite)
- Details: structured_tool_use
  - exact_match: -0.62 pp (CI [-1.10, -0.14])
  - json_valid_rate: -0.28 pp (CI [-0.60, +0.04])
  - tool_arg_consistency: -0.91 pp (CI [-1.60, -0.25])
- Policy gate: block if CI excludes 0 and delta > 0.5 pp for tool-use family

Selene Huang: per the quantization thresholds doc, tool-use family is strict for a reason. if CI excludes 0 on exact_match and we’re >0.5pp, that’s a block.

Jonas Weber: yeah the exact_match CI is fully negative. It’s not a huge hit but it’s statistically “real” given sample size.

Sana Farid: agree. I reran the stats locally w/ bootstrap + BH correction. Still flags tool_arg_consistency as significant.

Karthik Iyer: do we think this is calibration-set-related? or kernel change? 1.0.7 had the new calibration artifacts right?

Arjun Desai: 1.0.7 changed calibration set from rw-v2 -> rw-v3 (more mixed tool prompts). no runtime kernel change in this profile (still w8a16).

Jonas Weber: quick sanity: did latency/throughput improve on 1.0.7 vs 1.0.6?

Arjun Desai: perf is basically same. marginal VRAM improvement (~1.5%) but not enough to justify quality risk.

Olivia Grant: from harness POV, this isn’t a flaky suite. it’s deterministic enough; we see the same failure pattern across 3 seeds.

Selene Huang: then we shouldn’t publish “validated”. we can either (a) block publication entirely or (b) publish as experimental + not allow enablement in Console without explicit “I accept risk”. but v1 plan was: library only contains approved + compatible profiles.

Dr. Maya Srinivasan: I’d prefer we don’t publish this version at all. “Borderline” regressions are exactly what burns trust in the library.

Karthik Iyer: +1. also we don’t have a strong customer need to rush 1.0.7.

Jonas Weber: question: can we keep 1.0.6 as validated + mark 1.0.7 as blocked? so we don’t break any recommended alias behavior.

Arjun Desai: yes. we can set 1.0.7 status to `blocked_pending_recalibration` in registry metadata. and keep `recommended` pointing to 1.0.6.

Sana Farid: if we do that, can we capture the rationale in the profile notes? i.e., “fails structured_tool_use exact_match gate”. would help later.

Selene Huang: also add a note that this is *not* a compatibility issue. it’s quality. so policy engine fallback won’t help — must not be selectable.

Arjun Desai: makes sense. action item on me: update the PR / publish pipeline to stop promotion for 1.0.7.

Jonas Weber: do we want to do a quick additional run w/ larger sample size just to be 100%? or accept current gate.

Dr. Maya Srinivasan: gate is gate. if we keep rerunning until it passes, we’re gaming it. block and recalibrate.

Karthik Iyer: agree. we can still run more for diagnosis, but not for “unblocking”.

Olivia Grant: if you want debugging, i can pull a diff set of failing prompts + outputs. some of these are subtle schema/ordering issues.

Arjun Desai: please do. I suspect quant noise is pushing it over for tool arg normalization.

Selene Huang: also check if the structured suite uses strict string match on JSON key ordering. if so, maybe the issue is formatting drift rather than semantic.

Jonas Weber: it’s exact_match on normalized JSON (ordering-insensitive) + a separate json_valid. tool_arg_consistency is semantic.

Sana Farid: i can share the prompt IDs with biggest negative swing. it clusters around multi-tool calls.

Arjun Desai: ok decision: block publication of `@1.0.7` pending recalibration. keep `@1.0.6` as current validated.

Karthik Iyer: :thumbsup:

Selene Huang: :+1: please log it in the “profile lifecycle” notes too so Platform doesn’t wonder why version jumped but not published.

Arjun Desai: will do. I’ll:
1) set registry status `blocked_pending_recalibration`
2) add note: “fails rw_prompt_sets_v5 structured_tool_use exact_match delta -0.62pp (CI excludes 0)”
3) open a follow-up task: recalibrate using tool-heavy subset + rerun eval

Jonas Weber: and we should add a canary-only run for the recalibrated candidate before promoting again.

Olivia Grant: I’ll drop the failing prompt IDs + output diffs in a doc and link here.

EvalsBot: Reminder: publishing to Quantization Profile Library requires:
- status=validated
- passing suites: rw_prompt_sets_v5 (all)
- perf thresholds: p95 decode latency delta <= +3%

Arjun Desai: thanks. no publish for 1.0.7.

Dr. Maya Srinivasan: appreciate the discipline. let’s aim for a recalibrated 1.0.8 by next week, but only if it’s clearly green.

Sana Farid: I’ll add a note re: statistical power + recommended sample size for tool-use family so we don’t keep having borderline calls.

Jonas Weber: good. also consider adding a “gray zone” note in the playbook: if delta is within 0.1pp of threshold but CI excludes 0, still block. removes ambiguity.

Selene Huang: yes. we can propose that change in the thresholds doc.

Arjun Desai: ok I’m pushing the registry change now. will update once merged.

Arjun Desai: update: registry metadata patched; 1.0.7 is blocked. `recommended` remains 1.0.6. no customer-facing publish artifact emitted.

Karthik Iyer: :thumbsup:

Olivia Grant: doc w/ top failing prompts + diffs: https://drive.redwood.local/applied-ml/qpl/llama3-70b/1.0.7-structured-regression (internal)

Jonas Weber: looking — yep, arg value drift on `date_range` in tool call #2. that’s not just formatting.

Dr. Maya Srinivasan: great. proceed w/ recalibration plan. end thread.
